week1Recap.Aidan O'Sullivan_Andrew Wilson: Aidan exploded for a league-best 144.46 pts behind 1.01 draft pick Jahmyr Gibbs (31.1), Caleb Williams (37.26), and D'Andre Swift (31.9) to claim the opening week scoring crown and the #1 seed. Andrew, the 3-time banner king OG, put up a stout 120.96 pts anchored by Lamar Jackson (24.96) and Javonte Williams (21.7), but suffered the week's toughest heartbreak as Ja'Marr Chase (1.3) was held to just 2.2 pts. Andrew's costly 72.1% coaching efficiency left 46.7 pts stranded on the bench (including Jalen Coker's 31.8 eruption), allowing Aidan to push his active streak over L Central to 3 straight games.
week1Recap.Brendan Sanders_Brodie Pirtle: In the inaugural clash between the league's newest franchises, sophomore standout Brendan delivered 126.56 pts behind an electric 29.7-pt debut from rookie Ashton Jeanty (2.20) and a balanced assault from Chuba Hubbard (22.2) and Trey McBride (20.0). Brodie's expansion squad BloodSword2000 flashed scary high-end firepower behind Derrick Henry (2.17 / 34.8 pts) and Justin Jefferson (1.8 / 27.2 pts), but a 74.7% coaching efficiency left 35.1 pts on the bench (including Patrick Mahomes' 21.66 pts). Brendan rolls to 1-0 and locks down the #2 seed entering Week 2.
week1Recap.Nathan Wells_Michael Anderson: Nathan pushed his active regular-season winning streak over OG Michael to 3 straight behind a 35.66-pt masterclass from Josh Allen (3.26), Bijan Robinson (1.2 / 27.3 pts), and a 20-pt clinic from the Steelers defense. Michael, the most decorated manager in Pride Guys history without a chip (5 career podium finishes), squeezed out a flawless 100% coaching efficiency behind Jaxson Dart (26.6), but CTESPN's 107.00 ceiling couldn't match Nathan's firepower, dropping Michael into an 0-1 hole.
week1Recap.Austin Geller_Sean Belcher: In a marquee battle of former champions, 2022 winner Austin rode Kenneth Walker III (2.18 / 32.6 pts), Chris Olave (25.2), and JSN (1.7 / 24.2 pts) to a comfortable 118.66-pt victory—even while absorbing a -4 from Houston's defense. Sean, a 2x champion OG and 2025 runner-up, laid a dud with a league-low 92.72 pts as De'Von Achane (1.11 / 8.6) and Drake London (2.14 / 4.5) were locked down. Austin jumps to #4 while Sean plummets to #12 in the cellar.
week1Recap.Trace Bakulich_Phillip Busick: Pride Guys' all-time wins leader (73 regular-season wins entering 2026) made quick work of Phil, stretching his winning streak over Joey Chestnuts to 3 games behind Christian Watson (31.7), Jonathan Taylor (1.6 / 23.6), and a 15-pt Seahawks defense. Phil maximized his roster with a 100% coaching efficiency behind David Montgomery (27.4) and Dallas Goedert (21.7), but premium draft anchors Puka Nacua (1.4 / 9.9) and A.J. Brown (2.21 / 4.1) fizzled, leaving Joey Chestnuts stranded at 94.70 in the #11 slot.
week1Recap.Tyler Hicks_Dylan Soth: In the tightest battle of Week 1, Tyler spoiled the reigning champion's banner-raising week with a gritty 6.52-pt victory behind Amon-Ra St. Brown (1.9 / 23.7), Bucky Irving (16.8), and Chase Brown (2.16 / 16.3). Dylan, who rode a Cinderella run from the #5 seed to capture the 2025 title, was paced by Trevor Lawrence (26.1) and Zay Flowers (25.5), but paid dearly for benching Dalton Kincaid (17.5 pts) for Tucker Kraft (8.0 pts)—a +9.5 blunder that proved decisive in a 107.22 to 100.70 heartbreak.

week2Preview.Aidan O'Sullivan_Sean Belcher: Game of the Week: First place meets last place in a heavyweight clash of Pride Guys champions. Sean, a 2x champion OG, has historically dominated Aidan with an 8-4 record and an active 4-game winning streak dating back to 2023. But the script has flipped entering Week 2: Aidan reigns at #1 overall after dropping a league-high 144.46 pts behind 1.01 pick Jahmyr Gibbs (31.1) and Caleb Williams (37.26), while Sean (#12) must resurrect a sputtering offense that slumped to a league-low 92.72 pts in Week 1.
week2Preview.Brendan Sanders_Austin Geller: An undefeated top-4 showdown pitting 2025's breakout sophomore against the 2022 champion. Austin (#4) swept both meetings last season on his way to capturing the 2025 #1 seed, and enters boasting the league's longest active playoff streak at 4 consecutive seasons. Brendan (#2) was clinical in Week 1 (94% efficiency) behind rookie phenom Ashton Jeanty (2.20 / 29.7 pts) and Trey McBride, and now looks to avenge last year's sweep to cement his status as the early-season title favorite.
week2Preview.Nathan Wells_Tyler Hicks: An early clash of 1-0 unbeatens between two squads fresh off hard-fought opening week wins. Nathan has controlled the matchup history, holding a 4-2 regular-season edge (5-2 all-time) after eliminating Tyler in their lone postseason clash (2022 Wild Card, 142.00-131.50). Defense Contractor #1 (#3) flexed elite firepower behind Josh Allen and Bijan Robinson (1.2 / 27.3) in Week 1. Tyler (#6) counters with Amon-Ra St. Brown (1.9) and Chase Brown (2.16), aiming to prove his takedown of the defending champion was no fluke.
week2Preview.Trace Bakulich_Michael Anderson: Both OGs entering their 10th season square off in one of Pride Guys' longest-tenured rivalries. Despite Michael holding a 10-8 regular-season edge, these two founding pillars have remarkably *never* crossed paths in the postseason. Trace enters 1-0 after a 113.94 opening salvo, looking to build an early cushion for top-two bye contention behind Jonathan Taylor (1.6) and Christian Watson. Michael faces an urgent test to avoid an 0-2 hole, needing blue-chip receivers CeeDee Lamb (1.10) and Rashee Rice (2.15) to unleash their scoring ceiling.
week2Preview.Andrew Wilson_Brodie Pirtle: The league's 3-time banner king OG faces the expansion rookie for the first time *ever*. Andrew was snakebitten in Week 1, dropping a high-scoring 120.96 shootout after benching Jalen Coker (31.8 pts) and getting just 2.2 pts from 1.03 anchor Ja'Marr Chase. Brodie showed fearsome rookie firepower behind Derrick Henry (2.17 / 34.8 pts) and Justin Jefferson (1.8 / 27.2 pts), but also left 35.1 pts on his bench. With both squads sitting at 0-1, Andrew relies on veteran championship pedigree to avoid an unexpected 0-2 start.
week2Preview.Dylan Soth_Phillip Busick: High stakes in the basement as two 0-1 teams battle to avoid a dreaded 0-2 start. Reigning champion Dylan swept both head-to-head meetings against Phil in 2025 (including a 128.76-93.42 rout in Week 12) to tie their lifetime series at 2-2. Joey Chestnuts finished in last place in 2025 and desperately needs top draft picks Puka Nacua (1.4) and A.J. Brown (2.21) to find the end zone after combining for just 14.0 pts in Week 1. Dylan looks to clean up managerial mistakes and lean on his workhorse backfield of Saquon Barkley (2.13) and James Cook (1.12).

week2Recap.Michael Anderson_Trace Bakulich: Trace Bakulich delivered the performance of the season in Pride Guys, posting a league-high 159.78 pts with a flawless 100% coaching efficiency to rout Michael Anderson (106.50) by 53.28 pts. Jonathan Taylor (27.2), DeVonta Smith (24.7), and Bryce Young (24.08) formed an unstoppable triple-threat. Michael, Pride Guys' most decorated titleless manager, falls to 0-2 despite CeeDee Lamb's 33.30-pt display as Trace cuts Michael's regular season series edge to 10-9.
week2Recap.Tyler Hicks_Nathan Wells: Tyler Hicks stayed undefeated at 2-0 with an authoritative 130.48 to 96.72 victory over Nathan Wells. Amon-Ra St. Brown (32.7), Jared Goff (29.78), and a 21-pt clinic from the Patriots defense overpowered Nathan's squad. Nathan got a 40.82-pt masterclass from Josh Allen, but an offensive dry spell from the rest of Defense Contractor #1 dropped Nathan to 1-1 as Tyler pulled within 4-3 in their all-time regular season series.
week2Recap.Dylan Soth_Phillip Busick: Reigning champion Dylan Soth entered the win column with a 92.62 to 55.98 triumph over Phillip Busick. James Cook III (20.4) and Dalton Kincaid (19.0) provided just enough cushion in a defensive grind. Phil's Joey Chestnuts suffered complete offensive paralysis, tallying just 55.98 pts (the second-lowest score in the league) as Puka Nacua and A.J. Brown failed to reach the end zone, dropping Phil to 0-2 while Dylan pushed his series streak over Phil to 3 straight.
week2Recap.Austin Geller_Brendan Sanders: In an undefeated clash of title favorites, 2022 champion Austin Geller marched to 2-0 with a 119.38 to 95.04 win over Brendan Sanders. Jaxon Smith-Njigba was the player of the week, hanging an astonishing 40.0 pts alongside Kenneth Walker III (20.8) and Chris Olave (18.6). Brendan got 20.6 pts from Christian McCaffrey, but Stroking my penix couldn't keep pace as Austin improved to a perfect 3-0 lifetime against Brendan.
week2Recap.Aidan O'Sullivan_Sean Belcher: Aidan O'Sullivan remained spotless at 2-0, securing a 91.42 to 52.96 victory over Sean Belcher. Jahmyr Gibbs (20.3) and Denzel Boston (18.0) led JD Vance in Drag, while Sean endured an absolute catastrophe: Milkshake Baddies posted a league-worst 52.96 pts—the 4th lowest score in the modern era (2022+) of Pride Guys history—with Jalen Hurts managing just 16.16 pts. Aidan snapped Sean's 4-game winning streak against him and handed the 2x champion OG a stunning 0-2 start.
week2Recap.Andrew Wilson_Brodie Pirtle: Expansion history made! Rookie owner Brodie Pirtle captured his first career Pride Guys franchise win in emphatic fashion, dropping 134.68 pts to upset 3-time banner king Andrew Wilson (91.90) by 42.78 pts. Davante Adams (37.5) and Derrick Henry (16.2) led BloodSword2000's onslaught. Andrew got 23.0 from Ja'Marr Chase, but the rest of L Central sputtered, sending the storied champion into an alarming 0-2 hole.

week3Preview.Tyler Hicks_Michael Anderson: Tyler Hicks enters 2-0 with momentum surging after knocking off the defending champion and Nathan in consecutive weeks behind Amon-Ra St. Brown. Michael Anderson, however, finds himself in an unfamiliar 0-2 hole despite CeeDee Lamb's brilliance. Michael holds a 7-3 regular season edge over Tyler, but desperately needs his running game to awaken to avoid a catastrophic 0-3 start.
week3Preview.Trace Bakulich_Dylan Soth: Game of the Week: All-time wins leader meets reigning champion. Trace Bakulich arrives fresh off a 159.78-pt scoring masterclass (league high) behind Jonathan Taylor and DeVonta Smith. Dylan Soth got off the mat with a Week 2 win over Phil behind James Cook. Trace holds a 5-4 regular season edge and has taken their last two meetings; both 1-1 squads look to make a defining statement in this heavyweight rivalry.
week3Preview.Nathan Wells_Phillip Busick: A critical crossroad for two franchises looking to regain their footing. Nathan Wells (1-1) boasts elite firepower in Josh Allen and Bijan Robinson, looking to wash away a Week 2 setback against Tyler. Phillip Busick (0-2) is in urgent crisis mode, having scored just 55.98 pts in Week 2. Nathan has taken their last two meetings and holds a 6-3 series lead; Phil needs Puka Nacua to carry Joey Chestnuts out of the cellar.
week3Preview.Aidan O'Sullivan_Austin Geller: Undefeated Clash of Titans! The only two 2-0 teams remaining square off for sole possession of 1st place in Pride Guys. Aidan reigns behind 1.01 draft pick Jahmyr Gibbs and Caleb Williams, while Austin counters with JSN (coming off a 40-pt week) and Kenneth Walker III. Aidan leads their historical series 5-4; the winner takes early control of the inside track to the #1 overall playoff seed.
week3Preview.Brendan Sanders_Andrew Wilson: Championship pedigree meets sophomore firepower. Andrew Wilson, the league's 3-time banner king, is facing a 5-alarm fire at 0-2 following an upset loss to rookie Brodie. Brendan Sanders sits at 1-1 with Christian McCaffrey and Ashton Jeanty ready to rumble. Andrew urgently needs Lamar Jackson and Ja'Marr Chase to deliver a signature performance to prevent an 0-3 hole.
week3Preview.Sean Belcher_Brodie Pirtle: A tale of two opposite trajectories. 2-time champion Sean Belcher sits dead last in the standings at 0-2 after averaging just 72.8 pts over the first two weeks. He faces high-flying expansion rookie Brodie Pirtle, riding high after dropping 134.68 pts behind Davante Adams to earn his first franchise win. Can the veteran OG summon championship pride, or will the newcomer claim another legend's scalp?
